title: Information Synthesizer Schema
description: Schema for synthesizing search results into structured information for quiz generation

key_information.description: List of important facts or developments extracted from search results

recent_developments.description: List of recent developments with dates or timeframes
examples: As of November 2025, the latest research shows...

statistics_and_data.description: List of relevant statistics, numbers, or data points

summary.description: 2-3 sentence summary of the most important current information that would help create relevant, up-to-date quiz questions
